name: Cutting
summary: Incisions and wounds of separation. Cuts are gruesome work, an even uglier way to die.
effects: Injuries from Cutting are harder to Treat or provide First-Aid, inflicting a Bane on associated Tests.

injuries.name: Superficial Cut
injuries.text: A line of cold crimson, a weeping incision below the surface.
injuries.effect: You begin to Bleed.

injuries.name: Gash
injuries.text: Grimacing, open across and in-through sinew.
injuries.effect: You begin to Bleed and Risk Minor Panic.

injuries.name: Arterial Vent
injuries.text: Blood pours from the opening, its vacuum welcoming ice into your core.
injuries.effect: You begin to Bleed and Risk Major Panic.

name: Crushing
summary: The impressions of fists and hammers. These Injuries are not usually lethal, but generally debilitating.
effects: Crushing Injuries do not inflict Bleeding. When you suffer one, you become Stunned for 1d6 Turns.

injuries.name: Wheezer
injuries.text: A blow that steals the breath, but little more.
injuries.effect: You are Stunned for one Round and suffer 1 Strain.

injuries.name: Dazed
injuries.text: You come to your senses, if just.
injuries.effect: You suffer 1d6 Strain and are Off-Balance.

injuries.name: Tenderized
injuries.text: A blow that leaves more than a mark, a shatter-point that you must guard.
injuries.effect: You suffer 1 Strain and are one more Vulnerable.

injuries.name: Dislocation
injuries.text: Something comes loose.
injuries.effect: You Risk Moderate Panic, and lose the use of 1 Limb, chosen by the Attacker. If this is a leg, your Movement is halved. Flying Creatures fall if this is a wing.

injuries.name: Thoracic Fracture
injuries.text: A crack in your chest, each strenuous move comes with a grinding agony.
injuries.effect: You suffer Major Panic from pain, which inflicts Persistant Strain. Each time you are Injured after this, you Risk additional Moderate Panic.

name: Piercing
summary: Harm from stabs and arrows. While superior in piercing defenses, this tends to be a very unpredictable form of Risk.
effects: When you suffer a Injury of Minor or greater Severity, you begin to Bleed.

injuries.name: Graze
injuries.text: Your skin stings and ears whine from a brush much closer than comfortable.
injuries.effect: You are Off-Balance for 1 Round and suffer one Strain.

injuries.name: Remote Puncture
injuries.text: A hot line drawn through a foot or hand.
injuries.effect: One of your extremities at random is Injured. Tests with Injured hands are penalized by 1, and each foot or mobility-limb penalizes Movement by 1.

injuries.name: Gutshot
injuries.text: Your breath catches with the sudden loss of pressure within your abdominal cavity.
injuries.effect: You Risk Minor Panic, and this Injury is automatically Infected.

injuries.name: Rent Lung
injuries.text: A wheeze escapes your mouth, a dry-wet rasp betraying internal compromise.
injuries.effect: You Risk Moderate Panic from Pain and suffer a Penalty of 2 to your Body.

summary: The greater form of Piercing Damage, Impaling Damage is much the same, but far more lethal.
effects:
The greater form of Piercing Damage, Impaling Damage is much the same, but far more lethal.
- 7-12: -| Graze: Your ears ring, following a trench cut in the air.
- 3-6: Major| Socket Piercer: Grinding friction from a joint rendered useless.
- 2: Lethal| Headshot: Iron through the skull, taking thought and life along the line of flight.

injuries.name: Graze
injuries.text: Your ears ring, following a trench cut in the air.
injuries.effect: You suffer one Strain, and are Off-Balance and Stunned for 1 Round.

injuries.name: Socket Piercer
injuries.text: Grinding friction from a joint rendered useless.
injuries.effect: You lose the use of one of your limbs entirely (chosen by the Attacker). If this is a leg, your Movement is cut in half, suffering this to both legs makes your Prone. Flying Creatures begin to fall from this Injury.

injuries.name: Headshot
injuries.text: Iron through the skull, taking thought and life along the line of flight.
injuries.effect: You die.

name: Rending
summary: The greater form of Cutting Damage, hewing chops and sweeps of lethal potential.
effects: Harder to treat, as Cutting Injuries. All results, even a Swipe, cause Bleeding.

injuries.name: Swipe
injuries.text: A near-blow, the closeness its own kind of harm.
injuries.effect: You Risk Minor Panic and are Off-Balance for 1 Round.

injuries.name: Laceration
injuries.effect: You instantly lose half your remaining time to Bleed-Out.

injuries.name: Loss
injuries.text: Nothing left but a bleeding stump.
injuries.effect: You instantly lose half your remaining time to Bleed-Out and you lose a non-critical limb or bodypart of the Attacker's choice, with all the consequences following to Actions and Senses. Recovery does not restore the Lost part.

injuries.name: Decapitation
injuries.effect: You die.

name: Traumatic
summary: The greater form of Crushing Damage, tremendous force, limbs of awful size, falling beams, crushing and crashing structures.
effects: Unlike Crushing Damage, all results of Minor or greater Severity cause Bleeding.

injuries.name: Traumatic Graze
injuries.text: You roll away, confused but unharmed.
injuries.effect: You suffer one Strain and are Off-Balance for 1 Full_Turn.

injuries.name: Break
injuries.text: Recoiling, you live, but terribly wounded.
injuries.effect: You suffer the combined effects of a rolled Crushing and Cutting Injury.

injuries.name: Collapse
injuries.text: The force was simply too great.
injuries.effect: You die.

name: Frost
summary: Black gnawing at the shafts of your bones, rime in the veins, blue lips and cracked skin.
effects: All Frost Damage inflicts the Stunned and Off-Balance Conditions with a Duration in Turns up to the Strain suffered.

injuries.name: Shiver
injuries.text: A mere brush with the arctic.
injuries.effect: You Risk Minor Panic.

injuries.name: Bite
injuries.text: Numb, darkened streaks, almost like a bruise.
injuries.effect: You Risk Moderate Panic.

injuries.name: Black Burn
injuries.text: Deeper bites, killing at the extremities first.
injuries.effect: Roll Major Panic Risk. You suffer a penalty of 1 to all Tests made with you hands. If you do not receive Treatment within 24 Hours, this is Permanent and cannot be removed by normal means.

name: Voltaic
summary: Electrical power from bolts and blue arcs of light, streaks of hate that freeze the muscles and freeze the heart.
effects: Voltaic Damage Stuns you for Rounds up to your Tier.

injuries.name: Murmur
injuries.text: A twitch as the power passes by.
injuries.effect: You Risk Minor Panic and are Stunned for one Round for each 6 rolled.

injuries.name: Shudder
injuries.text: Dendritic lesions etched across the flesh.
injuries.effect: You Risk Moderate Panic and are Stunned_2 for one Round for each 6 rolled.

injuries.name: Tree-Scar
injuries.text: Black lines of burned skin, clawing deep inside.
injuries.effect: You Risk Major Panic and are Stunned_2 for each 6 rolled, and Stunned_1 until Recovery. If this Injury Incapacitates you, you die.

name: Incendiary
summary: Burns and caustic lesions, Incendiary Risk is a near promise of lasting harm.
effects: If you suffer sufficient Permanent Strain from Incendiary Damage to be automatically Incapacitated, you die.

injuries.name: Superficial Burn
injuries.text: A flash of pain quickly subsides as you find yourself almost unscathed.
injuries.effect: You Risk Minor Panic.

injuries.name: 1st-Degree Burn
injuries.text: Bright, hot and painful, a red bloom in the senses.
injuries.effect: You Risk Minor Panic which Inflicts Permanent Strain.

injuries.name: 2nd-Degree Burn
injuries.text: A cold, deep bite, inflammation in the skin and your own heart.
injuries.effect: You Risk Moderate Panic which inflicts Permanent Strain.

injuries.name: 3rd-Degree Burn
injuries.text: Something worse, loss of sensation and the dread of permanent disfigurement.
injuries.effect: You Risk Major Panic which inflicts permanent Strain and suffer a Penalty of 1 to Reflex and Body.
